# JC Borges

> JC Borges helps small businesses of any kind, anywhere, get found online: a website that works on every phone, Google Business Profile and map listings (Google, Apple, Bing), local SEO, reviews and a plain-English monthly report. Run by John Borges, a principal software engineer based in Rio Vista, California, working with clients by video and email.

Every engagement starts with a free online checkup: John searches for the business the way a customer would and sends a short report of what works and what doesn't. Prices are flat and in US dollars. Clients own their domain, site and accounts, and monthly care can be cancelled any month.

## Services

- [Websites](https://web.johncborges.com/#services): fast, mobile-first sites with easy ways to call, book or buy
- [Search and local SEO](https://web.johncborges.com/#services): Search Console, sitemap, page titles and business details search engines can read
- [Google Business Profile and map listings](https://web.johncborges.com/#services): Google, Apple Business Connect, Bing Places and key directories
- [Reviews](https://web.johncborges.com/#services): review request links, QR cards and reply templates
- [Domain, email and security](https://web.johncborges.com/#services): domain and hosting moves, email on your own domain, https and backups
- [Monthly report](https://web.johncborges.com/#services): visits, calls and searches, with one or two next steps

## Pricing

- [Google & listings fix-up](https://web.johncborges.com/#pricing): $350 one time
- [New site + care](https://web.johncborges.com/#pricing): $900 plus $69 per month
- [Care only](https://web.johncborges.com/#pricing): $49 per month for an existing site
